applicable_to: employees likely to interact with victims of human trafficking
law_references: Human Trafficking FAQs (California Coalition to Abolish Slavery and Trafficking)
Model Notice for Posting (Office of the Attorney General)
risks_or_constraints: Non-compliance with training requirements can result in legal action.
Posting requirements may vary based on county-specific federal Voting Rights Act provisions.
notes: Training must be completed by January 1, 2020.
New employees require training within six months of employment.
